title: Freedom Trail
summary: Given a string representing the code on the outer ring of a dial and another string representing a keyword, determine the minimum number of steps required to align each character of the keyword with the "12:00" position on the ring and press the center button to spell the keyword.
statement: Given a string representing the code on the outer ring of a dial and another string representing a keyword, determine the minimum number of steps required to align each character of the keyword with the "12:00" position on the ring and press the center button to spell the keyword. Each step involves rotating the ring either clockwise or counterclockwise to align a character with the "12:00" position, followed by pressing the button to spell the character. The process continues until all characters in the keyword are spelled.
constraints: 1 <= len(ring), len(key) <= 100; both contain lowercase English letters.
Every key character appears on the ring. Index 0 initially points upward; rotations persist between presses.
Each one-position rotation in either direction costs 1. Pressing a matching letter also costs 1, even without rotation.
hints: A repeated letter can be reached at several ring indices, which lead to different future costs.
Memoize by next key index and current ring position, not by key index alone.
For every matching ring index q, add min(abs(q-position),n-abs(q-position)) + 1 + spell(next,q); choose the minimum.
The key index strictly increases, so recursive states are acyclic. Cache each state and keep the ring position after every press.
editorial: Every solution next chooses some occurrence of the required letter. The shorter circular distance is optimal for that transition; pressing costs one additional step. Minimize over all occurrences because a locally nearest choice can be worse for later letters. Memoizing (key index,ring index) gives O(m*n^2) time and O(m*n) space for m=len(key), n=len(ring). The independent oracle uses unit-action BFS over rotations and presses, not this recurrence.

tests.explanation: Press g at index 0 (1), rotate two positions to a d (2), and press d (1). Total 4.
Rotate one position backward to e and press twice. Total 3: the ring does not reset between letters, and each press costs a step.
